Subject: ACME: Security & Private VPC follow-up / next steps

Hi Jamie — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary from today
- Goal: deploy Redwood in a private VPC for low-latency inference and data isolation; evaluate on-prem / air-gapped options for regulated workloads.
- Key compliance asks: SOC 2 status, GDPR data controls, potential HIPAA scope for PHI.

Agreed next steps
1) We (Redwood) to share: SOC 2 certificate, a deployment diagram for Private/VPC + on-prem variants, and an initial SSQ intake to match your vendor format. (See attached deployment diagram.)
2) Acme to share: any preferred network requirements (e.g., VPC peering, static egress IPs, firewall rules), and the Acme SSQ template if you want us to fill it directly.
3) Schedule technical follow-up: 60–90 min deep-dive with your infra/security team to walk the diagram and answer detailed questions. Please suggest 2x time slots next week.

Timing: we can get the SOC 2 cert and deployment diagram over to you by EOD tomorrow and the filled SSQ first pass by next Wednesday.

Attachments (from Redwood): redwood-deployment-diagram.pdf (application/pdf)

Notes for internal owners
- Marissa: I'll loop you for the compliance details and SOC 2.
- Dev: please prep an on-prem/air-gapped appendix for the diagram (network isolation, offline package options, required hardware).
- Neha: could you stand by for any detailed encryption/KMS questions during the tech call?

Thanks — look forward to continuing this.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
